definitions.explanation: Short for {職業安定所|しょくぎょうあんていじょ}, a public employment office where job seekers register, receive counseling, and apply for unemployment benefits. Commonly known as ハローワーク.

examples.japanese: {安定所|あんていじょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I'm going to the employment office.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{安定所|あんていじょ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{紹介|しょうかい}して→紹介する：05641_shoukaisuru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: My father got a job referral at the employment office.

examples.japanese: ⟦{失業|しつぎょう}→失業：03179_shitsugyou⟧⟦{保険|ほけん}→保険：01509_hoken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{安定所|あんていじょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{訪|たず}ねた→訪ねる：01182_tazuneru⟧。
examples.english: I visited the employment office to file for unemployment insurance.

notes:
Abbreviation of {職業安定所|しょくぎょうあんていじょ}. In everyday speech, the English-derived name ⟦ハローワーク→ハローワーク：28059_haroowaaku⟧ is more common; {安定所|あんていじょ} appears in formal documents and conversation among older speakers.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {安定所|あんていじょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}う→通う：01217_kayou⟧: to make regular visits to the employment office
- {安定所|あんていじょ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}する→相談する：01845_soudansuru⟧: to consult at the employment office
- ⟦{公共|こうきょう}→公共：11652_koukyou⟧{職業安定所|しょくぎょうあんていじょ}: public employment security office (full official name)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ハローワーク→ハローワーク：28059_haroowaaku⟧: the common, branded name for the same offices
- ⟦{人材|じんざい}→人材：11426_jinzai⟧⟦{紹介|しょうかい}→紹介：01432_shoukai⟧{会社|がいしゃ}: private staffing agency — fee-based, often for white-collar jobs
